assembly.why: observed: 18 pad-bearing part(s) on F and 0 on B, 1 reflow pass(es). every footprint BLOCK (#726): blocks sharing one reference are keyed with an ordinal suffix and counted separately. `pad_bearing` restricts that to blocks carrying at least one pad, and it is the count the populated-side verdict is taken from -- a zero-pad graphic on the back does not make a board double-sided.

blocks.name: xtal-loop
blocks.note: 12MHz loop on U1 pins 9/10, which at U1 rot90 sit at the NORTH end of its east pad row (134.62, 95.08/95.73). This is the free band between U1's north copper (94.91) and the north edge; it keeps the loop under ~3mm and leaves the U1<->USB1 gap free as the board's only north-south corridor.

blocks.name: serial-series-r
blocks.note: AMENDED after measuring the seeded board: with R3/R4 east of U1 (the original zone [135.55,99.20,139.50,102.40]) check_floorplan --health ranked them the board's two worst net-affinity pairs -- R4 carried 67% of /U0TXD (20.14mm to CON2.1) and R3 62% of /U0RXD (16.50mm to CON2.3). This zone is the free south channel between U1's south copper and CON2's pad row: it is NEARER U1's pins 3/4 than the old zone (2.8mm vs 4.6mm), which is where a series-termination resistor belongs, and it is ~10mm nearer the connectors both nets terminate at. Measured saving over the two resistors' four nets: ~14.3mm. Bounded x>=126.60 / x<=133.20 / y<=102.60 so it does not overlap the u1-decoupling [122.30,99.90,126.50,102.90] or vbus-regulator [133.25,102.65,145.40,105.20] zones -- the first draft of this amendment did, and check_floorplan raised intent_zone_overlap x2.

blocks.name: vbus-regulator
blocks.note: VBUS -> C1 -> U2 -> /+3.3V is the only loop that must stay compact and carry current; its three anchors are USB1 pin1 (140.70, 99.64), CON2 pin7 (132.12, 104.30) and U2 itself. This is the free south-east pocket east of CON2 and south of USB1's copper. AMENDED again after the boundary verifier: this zone was sized to U2's PAD bounding box (3.8 x 1.5mm), but U2 is a SOT89 whose F.Cu land pattern is an fp_poly spanning local y -2.4..+2.3 -- its real copper is 3.8 x 4.7mm, three times as tall. The south-east pocket is only 2.65mm tall, so it CANNOT hold U2 at any rotation; the old zone was unsatisfiable for this part and both the seeder and my lap 1 put U2's tab off the south edge (1.478mm and 2.180mm). The zone now reaches north to y=100.30 into the U1<->USB1 corridor, which is the only free area adjacent to USB1's VBUS pin that is 4.7mm tall.

blocks.name: u1-decoupling
blocks.note: C3 is U1's /+3.3V decoupling; U1's +3.3V pin 19 is on its WEST row at (127.38, 100.28), so the cap belongs immediately west/south-west of U1 rather than beside the regulator.

blocks.name: auto-reset
blocks.note: /DTR and /RTS leave U1's WEST row (pins 15/16 at (127.38, 97.68/98.33)); Q1+R1 and Q2+R2 are the two cross-coupled legs and their /DCOM and /EN outputs run on to CON1 (west edge) and CON2 (south). This is the west corridor, the largest free area left once the three connectors are seated.

blocks.name: fiducial-nw
blocks.note: Ref* is a netless 1x1 fiducial and is movable residue: USB1's declared east seat covers its carried pose. A fiducial wants a clear corner on the populated side, and the north-west corner is the only one not claimed by USB1 (east), CON2 (south) or CON1 (west-centre). Ref[*] is an fnmatch literal so this block cannot capture the locked Ref*~2.

context.fiducial_note: The `fiducial-nw` block was REMOVED and Ref[*] promoted to must_lock. Its pose stopped being seeder residue when the fourth boundary verifier measured that the north-west seat put 0.300mm of its 3.0mm clear area (an fp_circle r=1.5 on Dwgs.User) OFF the board, with CON1's silkscreen printing into it. The replacement seat (123.650, 93.200) was derived by a read-only search over the board for a point whose 1.5mm clear radius is free of the outline, all foreign pad copper, U2's footprint graphic copper and all silkscreen, while lying outside every part's body box: it measures a 2.185mm clear radius and a +0.700mm clear-area margin. A pose chosen by measurement is a decision, and a decision is must_lock, not a zone.
context.keepouts_note: 1 keep-out(s) DECLARED by the design brief board.design-brief.json. A keep-out is a mechanical fact and cannot be read off a board, so the emitter writes none; these came from the one channel that can state one. Since #701 the seat search honours them, not only the grade.
